author: Tanvi Joshi
content: Drawing recursion trees on paper was a complete game changer for me too! Especially with tree traversals and Tower of Hanoi.

author: Harsh Vardhan
content: Another tip: always keep track of call stack memory limit O(H) where H is recursion depth. If H = N, beware of stack overflow!

author: Sameer Rao
content: The low + (high - low) / 2 overflow bug was an actual question in my technical coding round! Crucial trick to know.

author: Pooja Patil
content: Marking nodes visited immediately when pushing into the queue is the #1 trick to prevent memory limit exceeded (MLE) in BFS.

author: Vikram Shinde
content: Sliding window with dynamic size (e.g. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters) becomes trivial once you track frequency maps.
